jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        
      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v6
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin' # See 'Supported distributions' for available options
          java-version:  '17'
          cache: 'maven'
          #server-id: ossrh # Value of the distributionManagement/repository/id field of the pom.xml
          #server-username: MAVEN_USERNAME # env variable for username in deploy
          #server-password: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_CENTRAL_TOKEN }} # env variable for token in deploy

          #gpg-passphrase: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_GPG_PASSPHRASE }} # env variable for GPG private key passphrase

      - name: Make Maven Wrapper executable
        if: contains(matrix.os, 'win') == false
        run: chmod +x ./mvnw

      - name: Build with Maven
        run: ./mvnw clean install

      - name: Samples processed ahead of time, tested on the AOT contexts
        run: ./mvnw -Paot -f samples clean verify

      - name: Set VERSION environment variable
        # the Maven wrapper (as for the build): the runner's own mvn can print a model warning to stdout,
        # which would end up in GITHUB_ENV; the last line is the version printed by -DforceStdout
        run: |
          echo "VERSION=$(./mvnw help:evaluate -Dexpression=project.version -q -DforceStdout 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
